constraints: width/height are derived from the form's Default window size property: automatic (sized to fit all objects plus margins), set (manually entered), or based on an object (sized relative to that object's position).
title returns an empty string if no window title was defined in the Form editor's Property List.

overloadMerges.note: width, height, numPages, fixedWidth, fixedHeight and title are all filled by the command (parameter table arrow '←'), so their direction should be 'out', not the syntax-position default of 'in'.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table form only: table of the form, or default table if omitted

params.name: width
params.description: Width of the form, in pixels

params.name: height
params.description: Height of the form, in pixels

params.name: numPages
params.description: Number of pages in the form, excluding page 0

params.name: fixedWidth
params.description: True if the form's width is fixed (set), False if resizable/variable

params.name: fixedHeight
params.description: True if the form's height is fixed (set), False if resizable/variable

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the form's window as defined in the Form editor's Property List; empty string if none defined

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the size, page count, resizability, and window title properties of the named form.
